_readme: §PER-CITY-MEASUREMENTS (L-662) — the three EXPENSIVE C63 axes (LEGISLATION 25 · ENVELOPE 20 ·
HEIGHTS 10 = 55 % of the ratified weight) are AUDITS, not config reads, so computeScorecard.mjs
will not score them without a committed, reviewable measurement record. Absent ⇒ not-assessed.
⚠ `status: 'measured'` is the ONLY key that unlocks an axis. Never set it to make a number appear.
⚠ Every figure below is CITED to an artefact or a probe. INV-3: cited derivation, never a guess.
⚠⚠ READ THIS BEFORE READING THE NUMBERS. València's ENVELOPE axis scores **0.00**, and that is a
MEASURED value with the article that makes it zero — NOT a `not-assessed`, NOT a failure, and NOT
something to be improved by writing a bigger number. Arts. 6.18.2 / 6.19.1 / 6.25.1 / 6.30.1 key
every envelope parameter to a value graphed on the Plano C sheets, which the municipality does not
publish as data. C63 §1.5 / L-656: a cited refusal is a CORRECT ANSWER, and a correct answer is not
an envelope. Writing this record LOWERS València's headline (the axis stops being renormalised away
and enters at weight 0.20 with score 0). That is the record working.

note: TWO NON-OVERLAPPING SLICES covering 100 % of the buildable denominator, so measuredShare = 1.0
and nothing is renormalised away. The axis score is 0.0000 — both tiers weigh 0.0.
⚠ THE TWO SLICES SCORE THE SAME AND MEAN OPPOSITE THINGS, which is exactly why C63 §3.2 keeps
them two words (EnvelopeAxisWeight.ts, the `no-pack` sentinel docstring):
63.60 % `no-pack`         → the PGOU orders this land ITSELF (`origen` LIKE 'PGOU%'), and PRYZM
holds no usable rule. This is PRYZM's coverage gap in FORM, but its
CAUSE is the municipality's: Art. 6.18.2 «La profundidad edificable
será la señalada en el Plano C» and Art. 6.19.1 «en función del número
de plantas grafiado en el Plano C». Plano C is not published as data.
Structurally identical to Murcia's street-width-blocked 8.81 pp.
36.40 % `not-determined`  → the plan EXPRESSLY delegates this land to a derived instrument (PE
A cited legal refusal naming the governing instrument: terminal, and
never an envelope.
⚠ HONESTY FLAG ON SLICE 2, and it UNDER-states rather than over-states. The tier describes what the
LAND is, measured. The SHIPPED runtime today emits the WEAKER `no-rule-pack` coverage refusal on
100 % of València parcels, because the live `origen` read at the parcel (CLOSURE-REGISTER #4) is not
wired. Both tiers weigh 0.0 so the axis score is identical either way; the distinction is recorded
because it is the difference between a cited legal answer and PRYZM's own gap.
⚠⚠ UPDATED 2026-08-02, AND THE SCORE DID NOT MOVE — WHICH IS THE POINT. This note used to read
'the arithmetic maximum is 0.0 until a human obtains PLANO C'. That premise is SUPERSEDED by
founder decision R1: the buildable DEPTH is resolved through the published layer-212 movement
geometry (Art. 6.18.1 sets the ocupación by the alineaciones; measured n=54, median mean-width
15.6 m, NEVER larger than its own calificación polygon 0/54, patio-de-manzana holes on 10).
⚠ CLOSING THAT BLOCKER SHORTENED THE PATH; IT ADDED NO COVERAGE. The ENVELOPE axis stays 0.0000
over 100 % of the denominator, and this record must NOT drift upward on the strength of a closed
blocker — that would be exactly the C63 §1.1 fabrication. The axis moves when `altura` is
authoritatively defined AND land is packed, not before.
⛔ WHAT NOW GATES THE AXIS IS ONE EXTERNAL ANSWER, not a data-acquisition project: the municipal
definition of layer 212's `altura` (VALENCIA_R5_ASK). Measured, that field sits BELOW the built
storey count on 81 % of sampled Ensanche buildings, modally by two, and ABOVE it on a minority —
a TWO-SIDED error, so ADR-0287 applies directly and no 'conservative branch' exists. ADR-0283:
UNKNOWN is a valid product state. Founder, 2026-08-02: 'No heuristic. No inferred semantics. No
workaround… Do not substitute engineering for legal interpretation.'
Category EXTERNAL AUTHORITY, owner the founder, exit = a written definition that also reconciles
the −2 gap (docs/04-reference/standards/BLOCKER-CLASSIFICATION-STANDARD.md).
⚠ 17 of 33 ArcGIS folders (incl. `Patrimonio_Historico`, `Vivienda`) answer 499 «Token Required» —
RE-PROBED 2026-08-01, still gated. UNKNOWN, never absent (L-422/457/467/469). Heritage constrains
envelopes DOWNWARD, so their absence cannot inflate this score — but it bounds what the sweep proves.
INDEPENDENT CROSS-CHECK (§probe-can-be-wrong-three-ways — never let one code path grade itself). The
dossier's shares came from a client-side shoelace over 21 210 downloaded rings. Re-derived 2026-08-01
server-side via SQL `st_area(shape)` on a DIFFERENT service (Tools/FichaUrbanismo/14, the same
21 210-row source table), the two agree within 0.2 pp:
all polygons 14 419.8 ha vs 14 419.8 ha · suelo urbano 3 998.9 vs 4 010.7 ha
L-656 buildable 1 869.6 vs 1 874.9 ha · PGOU-ordered 63.78 % vs 63.60 % · delegated 36.22 % vs 36.40 %
The committed dossier figures are kept (a 0.18 pp delta is not a re-measurement); what is established
is that the number survives an independent method. The UNFILTERED count `{"count":21210}` was asserted
FIRST on every run, and the `califi='ZZZNOPE'` control returned `{"count":0}` — byte-identical in SHAPE.

coverage.zoneCode: PGOU-ordered (origen LIKE 'PGOU%') — envelope CONSTRUCTED on Plano C, which the city does not publish (Arts. 6.18.2 · 6.19.1 · 6.25.1 · 6.30.1)
legally delegated to a derived instrument (PE/RI/MP/ED/PRI/PP/…) — cited refusal, terminal, never an envelope

note: DENOMINATOR = 6, the zones of *calificación urbanística en suelo urbano* that the PGOU's OWN
Art. 6.3.1 enumerates — CHP · ENS · EDA · UFA · TER · IND — and which the live service measures at
100 % of the L-656 buildable denominator. NOT the 3 we read (scoring cited/authored would report
100 % — the 'Barcelona-borrow' trap C63 §3 Axis 2 names). 3/6 = 50.0 %.
⚠ THE DENOMINATOR IS PARTLY SELF-FULFILLING AND THAT LIMIT IS STATED, NOT HIDDEN. The buildable
denominator was CONSTRUCTED by intersecting suelo urbano with these same six codes, so this axis
cannot detect a buildable zone the plan failed to enumerate. The basis is the strongest available —
the ordinance's own enumerating article — but it is an argument, not an independent census. The
ROUTING vocabulary is far larger: 110 distinct `califi` base codes and 551 code+grade combinations
live in `MapServer/231` (measured). That is a routing denominator, not a numeric one (findings/
VALENCIA-LAND-SHARE-MEASUREMENT-2026-08-01.md §2).
NUMERATOR = 3: ENS (Arts. 6.15–6.21), EDA (Arts. 6.22–6.25) and UFA (Arts. 6.26–6.41) were read
article by article from the municipality's own normative PDF and quoted VERBATIM — both cornice
formulas (⚠ ENS intercept 4.80 vs EDA 5.30), the ordinance's own 8-row Art. 6.19.1 height table, the
Art. 6.30.1 closed table, and three stated bounds. CHP · TER · IND are `not-read` / `unknown` in
VALENCIA_CALIFICACION_CLASSIFICATION and score ZERO. They are 20.58 % of buildable land but only
3.35 pp of it is PGOU-ordered, which is why CLOSURE-REGISTER #7 is P3, not P1.
⚠ A CITATION THAT YIELDS NO NUMBER IS STILL A CITATION, AND THAT IS THE POINT OF SPLITTING THESE TWO
AXES. València scores 50 % on LEGISLATION and 0 % on ENVELOPE from the SAME reading: the law was read
correctly and it refuses. C63 keeps them apart precisely so 'we read it and it refuses' is not
punished as 'we did not read it'.
⚠ signedVerification: FALSE, and unusually it is NOT a missing signature. `VALENCIA_ENVELOPE_VERIFIED`
is `false` and a founder signature CANNOT lift it, because `ES_VALENCIA_PGOU_PACK.zones` is empty by
construction — there is no number to sign. This is the first city in the register whose gate a
signature cannot lift (L-449). So València can never present as `human-reviewed` on this axis today,
and that is a true statement about the city, not a to-do.
⚠ documentInRepo: FALSE, and it is load-bearing (L-674). The quotes come from valencia.es's own
«10. Normas Urbanísticas. (Transcripción).pdf» (HTTP 200, 435 440 B, born-digital, 157 pp, checked to
carry no «sin valor normativo» disclaimer). It is NOT committed under corpus/pdf/ the way Barcelona's
DOGC 4893 is, so the verbatim quotes cannot be re-read from the repo. C63 routes that to DATA-SOURCES,
never as a silent discount here. ⚠ The STRONGER artefact — the Generalitat's Registro Autonómico
deposit `46250-1001 1991-0010`, whose filing path contains `46250 VALENCIA` — was retrieved (HTTP 200,
11.8 MB) but is an IMAGE-ONLY SCAN: `pdftotext` yields 0 characters. Concordance UNVERIFIED
(CLOSURE-REGISTER #5).
⚠ supersessionChecked: FALSE. `VALENCIA_PGOU_LATER_MODIFICATIONS` is `unverified`, NEVER `none`, and
there is positive evidence against `none`. ONE modification is closed by inspection: the
*modificación-adaptación* approved 14-XII-1993 (DOGV 07-II-1994, bound into the same PDF) touches
Art. 6.18 only as a parcelación-licence segregation-tolerance clarification and does NOT alter the
profundidad edificable or the alignment rule.
⭐ The rest of the census is now SCOPED (measured server-side 2026-08-01), and the inherited
instrument count was WRONG: `origen LIKE 'MP%'` returns 1 508 polygons across 169 DISTINCT
instruments — not the ~140 the register carried, a 21 % under-count. But only 106 of them touch
buildable land, they total 115.7 ha = 6.19 % of it, and 26 instruments carry 80 % of that
(5 carry 50 %: MP1775 · MP2098A · MP1711 · MP2109 · MP1984). ⇒ The research ask drops from
~140 documents to 26, and the whole class caps at 6.19 % of the city. Reading them still needs
the DOCUMENTS, which PRYZM does not hold — so this flag stays FALSE (CLOSURE-REGISTER #6).

heightsLod.source: tools/context-height-probe/probe.mjs --at 39.4699,-0.3763 --name valencia against the SHIPPED R2 tiles (buildings.pmtiles?v=L659a — the same bytes the browser reads, the same provenance ladder) — 2026-08-01, verdict `unmeasured`, 20/20 tiles read, 0 absent, 0 failed
note: ⚠ measured-lidar = 0 of 5 466. Not one footprint in València's shipped tiles carries the
`pryzm:height_src=measured-lidar` marker. The 9 `tagged` are OSM-surveyed `height` values, not MDS
samples. 63.2 % render the FABRICATED 9 m default; solidRenderFraction = 0.002, i.e. 99.8 % of the
València skyline a user sees is a translucent ghost massing.
⚠ THE AXIS SCORES tagged/total = 9/5466 = 0.16 %. `derived-levels` (2 002, 36.6 %) earns NO partial
credit — C63 §3 Axis 6 v1 + the §8 open founder decision. A floor count times an assumed storey
height is not a measurement.
⚠⚠ THIS RECORD IS A PRE-BAKE BASELINE, DELIBERATELY — exactly as Murcia's is. A national buildings
re-bake is IN FLIGHT on this SHA; re-probe and update this block after it publishes. Do NOT edit these
counts to predict the outcome (§SIZE-IS-NOT-PROVENANCE — a green bake is precisely what L-658 produced
while shipping nothing).
⚠ NOT Murcia's root cause. València IS declared in heightSources.mjs (REGION_SOURCE valencia =
'mds_edificacion') AND is present in MDS_CITY_BBOXES, so unlike Murcia it is inside the join's
retainBboxes working set and CAN be stamped. Nothing was edited under tools/context-bake/ for this
record (a national bake is in flight on this SHA).
⚠ ONE MEASURED DISCREPANCY, REPORTED NOT FIXED: MDS_CITY_BBOXES gives valencia [-0.42, 39.42, -0.30,
39.52] while the canonical terrain.mjs REGIONS `valencia` row is [-0.43, 39.40, -0.30, 39.52]. The
MDS bbox is the smaller of the two, so a ~0.01° western strip and a ~0.02° southern strip of the baked
region fall OUTSIDE the stamping set and can never receive a measured height. Every other Spanish city
in that list uses its terrain.mjs row verbatim. Flagged for the orchestrator to land as one commit.
